description: Tracks documentation page coverage for the notification-kit docs site. Every page is source-accurate against the notification-kit package src/. Resumable: add pages as the API grows.
buildGates: controlled browser: desktop home + mobile quick start

batches.summary: Initial complete baseline: all 28 pages authored source-accurate from the package src/ (index.ts, NotificationKit.ts, react hooks, types.ts, providers). Site builds clean.
Context guides optimized; obsolete Firebase deployment instructions removed; @types/react added; exact production build passed and rendered correctly in controlled desktop and mobile Chrome.

honestyNotes: Client-side push SEND is documented as unsupported (Firebase provider throws) — it is a server-side Admin SDK operation.
FCM topic subscribe/unsubscribe is documented as server-side only — the client throws a descriptive error directing to the backend.
permissions.openSettings() is documented as not implemented internally (zero-dependency design).
No fabricated download counts / benchmarks anywhere.
nextSteps: Routine context optimization is next eligible 2026-11-19. Re-audit content when the package public API changes. GitHub Pages deploys from main.
